headline: Binance Suffers Multi-Billion Dollar Hack, Triggering Crypto Selloff
summary: Cryptocurrency markets slid following a multi-billion dollar hack targeting Binance, with BNB coin dropping 6% within an hour.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, and security breaches on major platforms often trigger sector-wide liquidity and confidence concerns.

impacts.name: BNB
impacts.why: The multi-billion dollar hack on Binance directly led to a 6% price drop in the BNB token.

why_moved: A major security breach at a leading exchange raises systemic risk and theft concerns, prompting immediate liquidations across digital assets.
